First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Mild A pace, nobody left behind. It’s no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That’s the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Western Wheelers Socially Paced Monday Coffee Ride group ride

Western Wheelers Socially Paced Monday Coffee Ride is a road group ride in Mountain View, CA. It rolls every Monday at 9:00 am from Rengstorff Community Center.

A mild Monday morning ride, about three hours, at the club’s gentlest A pace with a stop at Cafe Borrone. The listing says nobody is left behind. Dates are posted from July 6 to December 28, 2026.
